stories.headline: Iran signals diplomatic engagement across multiple fronts
stories.summary: Iran is proposing an insurance scheme for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, positioning itself as a guarantor of safe passage through waters it controls. The move reflects Tehran's attempt to monetize its strategic chokepoint while signaling stability to global shipping, even as regional tensions and international pressure intensify around nuclear negotiations.

angles.headline: Iran plans to offer insurance for Hormuz transit: Will it work?
angles.summary: Iran is proposing an insurance scheme for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, positioning itself as a guarantor of safe passage through waters it controls. The move reflects Tehran's attempt to monetize its strategic chokepoint while signaling stability to global shipping, even as regional tensions and international pressure intensify around nuclear negotiations.

angles.headline: Iran sends response to US proposal to end war via mediator Pakistan
angles.summary: Iran has delivered a revised proposal to end the conflict through Pakistan's mediation, responding to the latest US peace initiative. The Iranian response reportedly contains limited concessions according to Iranian media assessments of the US position.

angles.headline: Why Iran’s choice of Beijing envoy signals an ‘unprecedented’ commitment
angles.summary: Iran appoints Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, a senior political figure, as its chief negotiator overseeing relations with China, elevating the diplomatic role and signaling the strategic importance of the bilateral relationship. The appointment reflects Iran's deepening alignment with Beijing as both nations navigate international sanctions and seek economic partnership alternatives to Western trade.

stories.headline: Ebola, hantavirus: Is the world prepared for the next pandemic?
stories.summary: Health officials are assessing global preparedness as Ebola and hantavirus cases emerge in various regions, prompting examination of outbreak response systems and surveillance capabilities. The Democratic Republic of Congo and other affected areas face ongoing challenges in containing the virus and preventing spread, with some cases now documented among international populations.

stories.headline: Russian drone hits Chinese ship off Ukraine before Putin visits Xi Jinping
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck a Chinese vessel operating in the Black Sea near Ukraine, an incident that occurs ahead of Vladimir Putin's scheduled visit to China. The strike highlights the risks faced by commercial shipping in the conflict zone and raises questions about coordination between Moscow and Beijing during a period of strengthening diplomatic ties.

stories.headline: Cruise ship hit by hantavirus outbreak docks in Rotterdam
stories.summary: A cruise ship carrying passengers and crew members with confirmed hantavirus infections has arrived in Rotterdam, where affected individuals can receive medical care and assessment. The outbreak prompted the vessel's early return to port, allowing health authorities to isolate cases and investigate the source of transmission among those aboard.

stories.headline: Watch: Moment two fighter jets collide mid-air at US air show
stories.summary: Two Navy fighter jets collided in midair during an air show in Idaho, with the impact occurring in front of spectators. All four crew members ejected safely from their aircraft before the collision.

stories.headline: Shakira wins £50m tax refund from Spanish government
stories.summary: A Spanish court has acquitted Shakira of tax fraud charges and ordered the government to return approximately €55 million (£50 million) in fines and penalties. The ruling determines that the tax authorities wrongly pursued the case against the Colombian pop star, resolving a legal dispute that had lasted several years.

stories.headline: Xi Jinping prepares to welcome Vladimir Putin to China, four days after hosting Donald Trump
stories.summary: China's leader hosts back-to-back summits with the U.S. and Russian presidents, signaling Beijing's effort to maintain diplomatic engagement with both major powers despite their mutual tensions. The compressed timeline underscores China's balancing act between competing geopolitical interests as it navigates relationships with Washington and Moscow simultaneously.

stories.headline: Bodies of missing Italian divers found in Maldives
stories.summary: Four Italian divers who went missing in the Maldives have been found dead in an underwater cave, ending a search operation in the region. The discovery provides closure to their families while investigators work to determine the exact circumstances of the accident.

stories.headline: Israeli forces board Gaza-bound flotilla near Cyprus, activists say
stories.summary: Israeli naval forces have intercepted a flotilla of aid vessels traveling toward Gaza in international waters near Cyprus. The interception represents another instance of Israel enforcing its blockade on Gaza, which has restricted the entry of goods and supplies since 2007.

stories.headline: US military carries out more strikes against ISIL fighters in Nigeria
stories.summary: The US military and Nigerian forces conducted additional strikes targeting Islamic State fighters operating in Nigeria's northeastern region. The coordinated operation resulted in at least 20 militant casualties as part of ongoing counterterrorism efforts in the area.
